newsitem.title: CHINA: Taiwan brokerage buys Shanghai consultancy firm.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan brokerage buys Shanghai consultancy firm.

text.p: A Taiwan brokerage has paid US$1.2 million to acquire a Shanghai consultancy company, the first time the Taiwan government has permitted such a purchase, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.
Hong Kong Core Pacific Securities International Company, a Hong Kong subsidiary of Taiwan's Core Pacific Securities Company, bought all the shares of Shanghai Jinhua Consultancy Company, it said.

This is the first time Taiwan has approved an application by a brokerage to acquire a Chinese consultancy firm since the Taiwan government allowed its securities firms to invest in China, it said, without giving any more details.
